purpose: Teach: エコロジー/ダーウィン/コンドーム/左脳/王宮/地球人/父兄/中尉

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、エコロジー団体への嫌がらせを、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police handle harassment cases against environmental groups, don't they?
lines.style: Measured, curious tone. Leaning slightly forward. Genuinely asking for confirmation, not testing. Soft emphasis on 'police' — seeking clarity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ダーウィン批判で過激化した団体を追われますね
lines.en: The police track organizations that became radicalized through Darwin criticism, yes.
lines.style: Clear, professional. Calm authority without coldness. Direct eye contact. Each phrase settled and definite, like confirming procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、コンドーム不正流通を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And the police also handle cases of illegal condom distribution, correct?
lines.style: Same curious rhythm as the first question. Slightly more confident now. Pause before 'illegal' — choosing the word carefully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、左脳の発達障害者の支援にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police also provide support for people with developmental differences affecting the left hemisphere.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, steady. No hint of judgment. Clinical but warm — speaking about vulnerable people without patronization.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、王宮警備の対応を、警察、されますね
lines.en: So the police also handle royal security response protocols?
lines.style: Continuing the pattern, but with a slight lift of uncertainty at the end. Like he's testing whether this really falls under police jurisdiction. Thoughtful pause before 'royal.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地球人類への脅威といったカルト犯罪も扱われますね
lines.en: The police handle cult crimes too — those that pose threats to humanity broadly.
lines.style: Serious tone. Slight weight on 'cult crimes.' Delivered like an important distinction. Clear and unhurried, acknowledging the gravity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、父兄を装った詐欺事案を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And the police investigate fraud cases where people impersonate parents, right?
lines.style: Building confidence in the pattern. Steady delivery. Slight nod of the head implied in the phrasing. Still genuinely asking, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、元中尉の方を防犯講師に招かれますね
lines.en: We've invited former lieutenant instructors to lead crime prevention seminars.
lines.style: Shift to warmer, slightly more personal. A note of pride — 'we've invited' suggests initiative. Slower on 'former lieutenant,' acknowledging the expertise.
